Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ رَبِّيْ وَ رَبُّكَ
Translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, my Lord and your Lord

Arabic text: اَللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: Allah, there is no god except Him, the Lord of all worlds

Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَنِيْ وَ خَلَقَكَ
Translation: All praise is for Allah who created me and created you
And ordained you in your stations
And made you a sign for all worlds
Allah boasts about you to the angels

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَ الْإِيمَانِ وَ السَّلَامَةِ
Translation: O Allah, make this moon appear upon us with security, faith, and safety

Arabic text: وَ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ الْغِبْطَةِ وَ السُّرُوْرِ وَ الْبَهْجَةِ
Translation: And Islam, joy, happiness, and delight

Arabic text: وَ ثَبِّتْنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ وَ الْمُسَارَعَةِ فِيْمَا يُرْضِيْكَ
Translation: And make us steadfast upon Your obedience and hastening towards what pleases You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ شَهْرِنَا هَذَا
Translation: O Allah, bless us in this month of ours

Arabic text: وَ ارْزُقْنَا خَيْرَهُ وَ بَرَكَتَهُ وَ يُمْنَهُ وَ عَوْنَهُ وَ فَوْزَهُ
Translation: And grant us its goodness, its blessings, its prosperity, its help, and its success

Arabic text: وَ اصْرِفْ عَنَّا شَرَّهُ وَ بَلَاءَهُ وَ فِتْنَتَهُ
Translation: And turn away from us its evil, its calamities, and its trials
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
